from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.lighting import get_lighting_plan_builder
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Lighting_Plan(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_lighting_plan"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("intent_text",   "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("environment",   "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("mood",          "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_input("subjects_json", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]
        self.add_output("plan_json", "string")
        self.add_output("plan_id",   "string")

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        intent_text   = str(inputs.get("intent_text",   "") or "")
        environment   = str(inputs.get("environment",   "") or "")
        mood          = str(inputs.get("mood",          "") or "")
        subjects_json = str(inputs.get("subjects_json", "") or "")
        try:
            subjects = json.loads(subjects_json) if subjects_json.strip() else []
            if not isinstance(subjects, list):
                subjects = []
        except Exception:
            subjects = []
        try:
            builder = get_lighting_plan_builder()
            plan    = builder.build_plan(
                intent_text=intent_text,
                environment=environment,
                mood=mood,
                subjects=subjects,
            )
            self.log_info(
                f"Lighting plan built: id={plan.plan_id}, env={plan.environment}, "
                f"mood={plan.mood}, volumetrics={bool(plan.volumetrics)}."
            )
            return {
                "plan_json": json.dumps(plan.to_dict(), sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "plan_id":   plan.plan_id,
                "exec_out":  True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Lighting plan build failed: {exc}")
            return {"plan_json": "{}", "plan_id": "", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Lighting_Plan
